items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1958-11-26
items.q: David Jones, I know you heard of him.

ctx.x: Now this guy here, we used to call him Nug. He's got one hand, that's all I've been known. That's the only name. And he was a bass drum player. Bass drum player. John Porter's brother, he's Joe Porter. Cornet. Second, second cornet. Floyd Jackson, bass player. David Jones, I know you heard of him.
Oh yes, he's out in California.

items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: David Jones didn't. That's the man did that. Professor Holmes? Professor Holmes.

ctx.x: Manuel Sayles was saying last night when we picked this up or night before that he thought David Jones got the credit for really introducing cards. Before that nobody ever paid any attention between one card and another here to know what they were. That he's one of the first ones around here at least that ever taught the fellas what chords to play on any instrument. That was really conscious of what one card from another.
David Jones didn't. That's the man did that. Professor Holmes? Professor Holmes.
